Each rule below has its own page. The list comes from the rules table in [`packages/rules/README.md`](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/README.md), and each page adds the rule's metadata and docs from `packages/rules`. The [checks guide](../guides/checks.md) shows how they run.

| Rule | Tool | Catches | Enable via |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [comment-discipline](eslint/comment-discipline.md) | ESLint | Top-level narrative, multiline comments, adjacent groups; keeps one-line whys beside code | `configs.recommended` |
| [no-broken-relative-links](eslint/no-broken-relative-links.md) | ESLint | Relative Markdown links to untracked paths | `@house-rules/rules/markdown` |
| [design-no-raw-color](eslint/design-no-raw-color.md) | ESLint | Raw hex, rgb(), hsl(), etc. in CSS | `design()` factory |
| [design-no-raw-color-literal](eslint/design-no-raw-color-literal.md) | ESLint | Raw hex, rgb(), hsl(), etc. in JS/TS strings | `design()` factory |
| [design-no-unknown-token](eslint/design-no-unknown-token.md) | ESLint | `var(--name)` with no definition | `design()` factory |
| [design-scale-value](eslint/design-scale-value.md) | ESLint | CSS values off a fixed scale | `design()` factory |
| [use-case-is-capability](eslint/use-case-is-capability.md) | ESLint | A use-case file that does not export exactly one `implement(...)` capability, exports a second contract, or exports another value | `configs.capability` |
| [no-hand-rolled-surface](eslint/no-hand-rolled-surface.md) | ESLint | `Tool.make`, `Rpc.make`, or `HttpApiEndpoint.<method>` outside `packages/capability/**` | `configs.capability` |
| [no-cycles](dependency-cruiser/no-cycles.md) | Dependency Cruiser | Circular imports | `layout({ scope })` |

| [packages-public-entry-only](dependency-cruiser/packages-public-entry-only.md) | Dependency Cruiser | Imports of package internals | `layout({ scope })` |
